tasks.subject: Task 0: Database tables — delivery_receipt + delivery_receipt_line
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create delivery_receipt and delivery_receipt_line tables with RLS.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/delivery_receipt_tables.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Both tables exist with correct columns and constraints
- [ ] RLS enabled; tenant isolation policy on both tables
- [ ] status check constraint enforces ('unmatched','po_linked','discrepancy')
- [ ] stock_in_reason check constraint enforces six allowed values
- [ ] quantity_delivered > 0 enforced on receipt line

**Verify:** `supabase db reset` completes without error

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/delivery_receipt_tables.sql"], "verifyCommand": "supabase db reset", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Both tables with constraints", "RLS with tenant isolation", "status check constraint", "stock_in_reason check constraint", "quantity_delivered > 0"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: receive_delivery_receipt RPC + retire old RPCs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Atomic RPC that writes inventory movements, updates PO line quantities, auto-closes POs, sets receipt status. Drops old receive RPCs.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/receive_delivery_receipt_rpc.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] receive_delivery_receipt(uuid) callable by authenticated role
- [ ] Each receipt line produces an inventory_movement row
- [ ] Linked PO lines have quantity_received incremented
- [ ] Receipt status computed correctly
- [ ] PO auto-closes when all lines fully received
- [ ] Old RPCs dropped

**Verify:** `supabase db reset` then `\df receive_delivery_receipt` shows function

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/receive_delivery_receipt_rpc.sql"], "verifyCommand": "supabase db reset", "acceptanceCriteria": ["RPC callable", "inventory_movement rows created", "PO line quantity_received updated", "receipt status set", "PO auto-closes", "old RPCs dropped"]}
```
